title: Commit the pass you previewed: per-row opt-out and a changed-since-preview report
deviations_from_card: (1) TENANCY per the coordinator (overrides card case 4's 'declined' verdict): a commit carrying `approved` runs a pass SCOPED to the caller's workspace (entriesForPass filters the snapshot before scoring/Python), and applyPassDecisions drops any other team's decision as a second wall (planCommit verdict 'foreign'). Other teams' rows are neither applied by the caller nor recorded as held back; the test proves a foreign row stays put, is absent from the result, and is then applied by its own team's unselected commit. (2) The commit loop was extracted into exported applyPassDecisions(decisions, entries, summary, selection?) so the executed cases run on the unit DB without spawning Python; behaviour without a selection is byte-identical (loop moved, not changed). (3) A declined REJECT is decided after the fairness backstop: a reject the backstop refuses stays an autonomous hold with its alert; only a fairness-cleared, unticked reject is skipped (no rejection_review queued). (4) Beyond the write set: app/_lib/scheduler-tenancy.test.ts (source guard that pinned the old '(all teams)' commit button; now pins its absence and the othersOnly notice) and perf-budget.json (app/page.tsx maxKb 8860 -> 8875 under the lock, +1 module/+14.7 KB measured, module ceiling unchanged). (5) useAutomationPass keeps the modal open with the report only when something needs saying (drift or a joined pass); a clean commit closes as before and the PassStrip shows the summary. The catalog key pipeline.tab.previewApplyGlobal is now unused and left in place (no gate flags unused keys).
notes: Response adds drifted[{entryId, approvedAction, approvedToStage, action, toStage}], declined, selectionHonored (only when `approved` was sent). Callers without `approved` (scheduler clock, /api/pipeline/command, cron) unchanged. tsc: errors only in the untracked foreign kpi-sim/** tree. test:perf red only on job-ingest.ts 403/400 (known) and app/_lib/db.ts 28/27 value importers (a sibling's test files; none of mine import db.ts). Full test:unit 9740/9740 green (the first run's jds ingest-job limiter and recipe-literal failures were a sibling's in-flight files and my amber drift row, respectively; the latter fixed by composing NOTICE('amber')). Known gap recorded in docs/features/pipeline/README.md: a scoped pass filters the same 2,000-row capped global snapshot, so past the cap a team's rows compete with other teams' for slots. No Python touched, so the pytest gate was not re-run.
